propositions.name: michelson_morley_negative_results
propositions.statement: The Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays gave negative results.
propositions.quote: to explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays, at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion, has been tested by Rayleigh

propositions.name: contraction_hypothesis_explains_results
propositions.statement: The FitzGerald-Lorentz Contraction Hypothesis is proposed to explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment.
propositions.quote: The FitzGerald-Lorentz "Contraction" Hypothesis to explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays, at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion, has been tested by Rayleigh in his experiments

propositions.name: contraction_magnitude_correction
propositions.statement: The assumed contraction is in error by a half and should be smaller than first assumed.
propositions.quote: The first assumption is apparently in error by a half and should be 0.5 × 10 .

propositions.name: index_excess_proportional_density
propositions.statement: The excess of the index above unity is proportional to the density.
propositions.quote: and also the excess of the index above unity to be proportional to the density.

propositions.name: proportionality_invalid_for_glass
propositions.statement: The assumption that the excess of the index above unity is proportional to density does not seem entirely valid for glass.
propositions.quote: The second assumption does not seem to be entirely valid for glass, at least, when compared with the double refraction produced by a given strain.

propositions.name: rayleigh_test_inconclusive
propositions.statement: The method of Rayleigh is not a conclusive test of the hypothesis, though it is the only experimental one attempted.
propositions.quote: the method of Rayleigh cannot be regarded by any means as a conclusive test of the hypothesis, it is the only experimental one attempted and can be extended so as to give a safe margin for a solid like glass.

propositions.name: contraction_from_intermolecular_forces
propositions.statement: The contraction hypothesis arises from considerations of intermolecular forces analogous to the interaction of electric and magnetic forces mediated through the æther.
propositions.quote: This suggestion of the "contraction" hypothesis by Lorentz, from considerations in regard to intermolecular forces analogous to the interaction, through the mediation of the æther, of electric and magnetic forces, is certainly plausible enough to warrant further examinations and extension experimentally.

propositions.name: intermolecular_forces_stable
propositions.statement: The intermolecular forces in the media used are not altered by factors many times less than those obtained by Rayleigh.
propositions.quote: That the intermolecular forces are not altered by factors many times less than those obtained by Rayleigh, is found to be the case in the media used.

propositions.name: earth_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: The earth has an orbital motion through which the plane of polarization can be shifted relative to it.
propositions.quote: the other a similar system rotating about a horizontal axis so as to shift the plane of polarization from a position at 45° to the earth's orbital motion through an angle of 90°.

propositions.name: sunlight_path_through_water
propositions.statement: Sunlight can be thrown into the trough of water so that its path through the water remains the same whatever the trough's position.
propositions.quote: In order to obtain sufficient intensity through the total column, the 2856 cms. of water used, sunlight was so thrown into the trough as to keep its path the same whatever its position.

propositions.name: nicols_polarize_light
propositions.statement: Nicols have principal planes that can be crossed to act on the plane of polarization of the ray.
propositions.quote: The principal planes of the nicols were crossed and at 45° to the vertical plane.

propositions.name: water_contains_air
propositions.statement: Water contains air that can form bubbles causing diffused light unless the water is heated to drive the air out.
propositions.quote: Water which had been heated to drive out air and prevent minute bubbles forming in it and upon the mirrors and thus causing diffused light was then flowed into the trough until it covered the analysing and polarizing systems.

propositions.name: crossed_nicols_extinguish_light
propositions.statement: Nicols adjusted for extinction, with the mica sections removed, give a field that is fairly completely dark.
propositions.quote: With the mica sections removed the nicols were adjusted for extinction, which was fairly complete.

propositions.name: glass_strain_produces_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A piece of glass compressed to the slightest degree shows a sharp change of intensity, that is, double refraction produced by strain.
propositions.quote: A small piece of glass compressed vertically to the slightest degree with the fingers placed after the polarizer 4 showed a sharp change of intensity at this bounding line.

propositions.name: no_double_refraction_water_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: There is no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the æther, to the order of sensibility attained.
propositions.quote: Hence, we may conclude that to this order of sensibility there is no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the æther.

propositions.name: earth_magnetic_field_rotates_polarization
propositions.statement: The earth's field of force could produce a rotation of the plane of polarization.
propositions.quote: It is evident that a rotation of the plane of polarization due to the earth's field of force would not affect this match, as both portions of the field would vary in intensity by the same amount.

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_direction_fixed
propositions.statement: The rotation of the plane of polarization due to a magnetic field is always in a definite direction independent of the direction of the ray, and is reversed with respect to an observer moving with the trough.
propositions.quote: It is evident that since the rotation due to a magnetic field is always in a definite direction and independent of the direction of the ray, such a rotation of the plane of polarization would be reversed with respect to an observer moving with the trough.

propositions.name: turpentine_verdet_constant
propositions.statement: A cell of turpentine gives a rotation, and water has a definite Verdet's constant relating the earth's field and a length of path to a rotation.
propositions.quote: A second check was made with a cell of turpentine 1.6 mm. thick, whose ends were made with thin cover-glasses without double refraction, which would give a rotation of about 0°.5, while if we take 0°.015 as Verdet's constant for water

propositions.name: quarter_wave_plate_order
propositions.statement: The mica quarter-wave plate has an order of approximately one quarter for green light, as found by comparison with a quartz or selenite wedge.
propositions.quote: The order of the mica quarter-wave plate was found to be approximately ¼ for green light, λ=0.00005 cm., by comparison in the usual way with a quartz or selenite wedge.

propositions.name: compensator_proportional_quarter_wave
propositions.statement: The rotation of the compensator is proportional to that of the quarter-wave plate for small angles.
propositions.quote: It was found that the rotation of the compensator was proportional to that of the quarter-wave plate approximately for these small angles.

propositions.name: weight_produces_retardation_glass
propositions.statement: Adding a weight to the vertical crown-glass strip produces a relative retardation that gives a match on rotating the compensator.
propositions.quote: On adding 200 gms. a match was obtained on rotating the compensator through 2°.5.

propositions.name: water_index_value
propositions.statement: Water has an index of 1.33.
propositions.quote: The total path of the light in the water was 2856 cms. Taking its index as 1.33, the number of waves is

propositions.name: double_refraction_velocity_difference
propositions.statement: Double refraction is the difference in velocity or in index between two components of light.
propositions.quote: This represents the greatest difference in velocity or in index between the two components which could exist referred to that of water for green light, λ = .00005 cm.

propositions.name: mascart_density_index_water
propositions.statement: In water under compression the increment in the excess of the index above unity is nearly proportional to the increment of its density.
propositions.quote: Mascart has shown that in the case of water under compression the increment in the excess of the index above unity is nearly proportional to the increment of its density.

propositions.name: motion_through_aether_increases_density
propositions.statement: Movement of matter through æther could produce an increase in density in the direction of motion, producing a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems similar to that which occurs in glass.
propositions.quote: If in the movement of matter through æther an increase in density in this direction took place, producing a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems similar to that which occurs in glass

propositions.name: contraction_effect_larger_than_sensitivity
propositions.statement: The greatest change expected on the contraction hypothesis is about 1600 times greater than the smallest effect which could be observed.
propositions.quote: or about 1600 times greater than the smallest effect which could be observed.

propositions.name: molecular_vibration_frequency_change_negligible
propositions.statement: A change in frequency of the moving molecular vibrations relative to the æther impulses in the direction of motion has an effect on the index that is far too small to be observed.
propositions.quote: on the index of the moving molecular vibrations relatively to the aether impulses in the direction of motion, is far too small to be observed.

propositions.name: water_index_depends_on_frequency
propositions.statement: The index of water changes with a change of frequency of the light.
propositions.quote: is 1.341. This gives for a fractional increase in frequency of 4/3 a fractional increase in index of

propositions.name: glass_slab_double_refraction_bands
propositions.statement: Examination with the analyser of the glass prism shows vertical bands, regular and symmetrical on each side of a central black band.
propositions.quote: On examining with the analyser, vertical bands (they appeared horizontal of course) were seen which were quite regular and symmetrical on each side of a central black band.

propositions.name: flint_glass_cylinders_index
propositions.statement: Cylinders of flint-glass have a mean index of 1.77.
propositions.quote: Two cylinders of flint-glass, each 22.3 cms. long and 2.4 cms. in diameter, and of mean index n D =1.77, were mounted on adjustable supports between the polarizing and analysing systems.

propositions.name: magnetic_field_double_refraction
propositions.statement: Double refraction of light can be produced by propagation at right angles to the lines of force in a magnetic field.
propositions.quote: These cylinders were especially well annealed Jena glass used a number of years ago in experiments on the double refraction of light propagated at right angles to the lines of force in a magnetic field .

propositions.name: temperature_changes_disturb_match
propositions.statement: Temperature changes, such as from the contact of the fingers, disturb the match in the glass system.
propositions.quote: The slightest contact of the fingers, however, usually disturbed the match, in consequence of temperature changes.

propositions.name: glass_double_refraction_velocity_difference
propositions.statement: The greatest difference in velocity or in index between the two components which could exist in this kind of glass can be calculated from the observations.
propositions.quote: which is the greatest difference in velocity or in index between the two components which could exist in this kind of glass.

propositions.name: wertheim_young_modulus_flint
propositions.statement: Faraday's flint glass has a Young's Modulus and a definite relation between dynes on a millimetre cube and relative retardation.
propositions.quote: If, on the other hand, we take Wertheim's results for glass, we have approximately for Faraday's flint, 5 x 10 n as Young's Modulus and

propositions.name: poisson_ratio_correction
propositions.statement: A correction by a factor involving Poisson's ratio should be applied if the interference problem were done on a glass support.
propositions.quote: If we correct by ¼ for Poisson's ratio, as we should if the interference problem were done on a glass support, the calculated contraction becomes

propositions.name: contraction_hypothesis_cannot_explain_or_aether_moves_with_matter
propositions.statement: If the test is valid, the contraction hypothesis cannot explain the negative results of the interference experiments, and either the æther moves with the embedded matter, or the effect of the relative motion on the intermolecular forces and the possible consequent relative change in dimensions is very small.
propositions.quote: Hence, if the test is a valid one, the "contraction" hypothesis cannot explain the negative results of the interference experiments; and, with the same reasoning, we also conclude either that the aether moves with the embedded matter, or that the effect of the relative motion on the intermolecular forces and the possible consequent relative change in dimensions are very small.

propositions.name: february_repeat_earth_velocity_conspires
propositions.statement: The earth's orbital velocity conspires approximately with that of the solar system in space at a particular time of year.
propositions.quote: These experiments were repeated during the early part of February, 1904, when the earth's orbital velocity conspires approximately with that of the solar system in space.

propositions.name: no_effect_detected_repeat
propositions.statement: No effect could be detected when the experiments were repeated under conditions as favourable as before.
propositions.quote: The conditions for observation were quite as favourable as before; but no effect could be detected.

propositions.name: hicks_elongation_alternative
propositions.statement: A more rigorous discussion than that of Lorentz shows that instead of a contraction in the direction of drift there should be an elongation.
propositions.quote: Hicks , in a more rigorous discussion than that of Lorentz, of the effect to be expected in the Michelson-Morley experiment, shows that instead of a contraction of

propositions.name: experiment_should_disprove_hypothesis
propositions.statement: The experiment should disprove the FitzGerald-Lorentz hypothesis by accounting for the negative results of the observations through elongation rather than contraction.
propositions.quote: to account for the negative results of the observations. The experiment itself should thus disprove the FitzGerald-Lorentz hypothesis.
